title: Heritage Short storyboard
description: The contract between every pipeline stage. Each stage reads this file; nothing creative is hidden in code.

title_native.description: Film title in the narration language.

slug.description: File-name stem for the exports, e.g. 'wonder_in_stone' -> outputs/final/wonder_in_stone_vertical.mp4.

end_card_title.description: Closing line shown large on the end card, above the AI disclosure.

version.description: Bumped on every storyboard revision (logged in DESIGN.md).

narration.description: ISO 639 code of the spoken narration, e.g. 'am' for Amharic.

subtitles.description: ISO 639 code of the burned-in subtitles, e.g. 'en'.

style_block.description: Fixed look description (medium, palette, light, texture) appended to EVERY image prompt to prevent style drift.

object_glossary.description: Fixed descriptions of culturally specific objects (e.g. jebena). When a prompt mentions the key, its description is appended, so models draw the real object instead of a generic look-alike.

description.description: Fixed, generic character description reused verbatim in every prompt that shows them. Never a real person.

reference_image.description: Path to the approved golden reference (set in Phase 2).

tts_style.description: Plain-language delivery instruction, e.g. 'warm, calm, unhurried'.

caption.description: Style, mood, instruments, texture for ACE-Step. Tempo/key go in their own fields.

intent.description: What the music does here: starts, builds, drops, resolves.

id.description: Stable shot id, e.g. s01. Used for caching and single-shot regeneration.

reason.description: Why this shot exists, in one sentence.

duration_sec.description: Planned length; assembly extends it if the measured narration is longer.

characters.description: Character ids from style.characters that appear in this shot.

image_prompt.description: What the still shows (subject, action, setting, composition). The style block is appended automatically.

motion_prompt.description: Motion and camera only, for image-to-video. Don't re-describe the subject.

camera.description: Also drives the Ken Burns fallback direction.

sfx.description: Quiet sound effects synthesised by pipeline/sfx.py and mixed under the narration (added after User Test #1, P2).

narration.description: Spoken line in the narration language. May be empty for a music-only shot.

subtitle.description: English subtitle for this line. Empty only if narration is empty.
